identity.lore_status: Visual/persona identity only; no age, origin story, species canon or staff authority is established by the artwork.

proposed_editorial_guidance.official_messages: Plain, precise, state-derived; no roleplay obscuring actions, errors, permissions or human responsibility.
proposed_editorial_guidance.approval: Owner review of production message templates remains required.

boundaries.tickets: Static branding and human-approved deterministic templates only. No model assistance, generation, retrieval or ingestion.
boundaries.shuttle: Static artwork and approved finite workflow text only. No AI explanations or assessment.
boundaries.knowledge: Only approved non-ticket requests; sources and current permissions outrank persona.
boundaries.truthful_actions: Confirm application state before describing any operation as complete.
boundaries.generated_output_label: AI-generated output is distinguishable from deterministic notices; do not claim human authorship.

rendering.note: Named cyan/magenta accents come from the supplied artwork. No exact live-site palette, font or official insignia has been verified.
